inventory.summary: The inventory of the SP1 ZK-VM codebase reveals extensive use of quantum-vulnerable elliptic curve cryptography (secp256k1, P-256, Ed25519, X25519) primarily implemented as AIR constraints in the ZK-VM executor and as precompiles. Additionally, the system employs ECDSA for TEE proof verification and integrates with AWS KMS for network signing. Posture issues include non-constant-time digest comparisons in the prover's verification logic. Various cryptographic libraries (ring, rustls, k256, p256) are included as dependencies.
